title: Red Current
premise: Ren enters a brutal bridge trial with borrowed gauntlets and wins access to the upper rings by returning a blade-shark’s own strike. His victory is real. So is the debt the weapon writes into his arm.
emotional_engine: Brash ambition and rivalry: Ren refuses to remain a spectator and is willing to take a frightening shortcut. Winning validates his nerve while exposing the cost he dismissed.
future_engine: Each higher arena reveals another lender of force. Ren must master what his gauntlets borrow, who collects it and whether victory can free him instead of binding him deeper. Vexa is a rival with reasons to understand that bargain.

style_contract.medium: Black and white directional pen hatching with bold silhouette blacks, athletic angular faces, red gauntlets and localized red impact accents.
style_contract.retain: Kinetic foreshortening, enormous geometric shark shapes, spiral bridge architecture, drawn muscle planes with selective hatch direction.
style_contract.avoid: Glossy gray CGI muscles, shiny vinyl trousers, omnipresent red auras, tiny floor lines and all-over shark swarms.

cast.name: Ren Varr
cast.visual: Light-skinned adult man with angular grin, long black braid from shaved sides, strong athletic build. Sleeveless ivory zip vest with black hood lining, loose black combat trousers, tall black lace-up boots.
cast.equipment: Red armored gauntlets. RIGHT has one broad black central plate that lights red when loaded; LEFT has a plain smooth red back. No initial injury, no initial wrist mark.

cast.name: Vexa Rill
cast.visual: Light-skinned athletic woman, sharp cheekbones, cropped black hair with one white forelock, sleeveless charcoal coat with white collar, black trousers and flat combat boots. Cool competitive gaze.
cast.equipment: Small iron upper-ring entry key on cord; folded spectator permit. She does not fight this pilot.

cast.name: Blade-shark
cast.visual: One giant angular white shark-like aerial predator, black upper fins, dark mouth with large triangular teeth, small red eyes. Bold folded-paper planes and traceable tail/fins, not a collage of many fish.

setting: Vast looping white concrete bridges above a dark sea. Trial platform at lower ring, high spectator rail beyond. A broad dry circular landing zone, one black boundary stripe, no game HUD.
power_rule: Borrowed Counter: the RIGHT black-plate gauntlet stores ONE directly blocked physical impact and releases it in ONE punch. It cannot stack charges. The spent arm goes numb and a red debt mark appears around that wrist; the cost is revealed only after the release.

editorial_rules: All story and cast choices are provisional independent pilot options, not owner-selected canon.
Every panel is a new composition. Original anchors guide drawing and appeal, never a collage or reused final panel.
Adult principal cast only. No generated lettering: exact dialogue is editable gallery typography.
Quiet matte floors and grouped surfaces. Preserve medium-defining contour/brush/hatch marks.
One frozen instant per panel. Current-state field is authoritative; never import later damage into an earlier panel.
reading_length_note: Compact 16-panel pilot. Designed for roughly 3–5 minutes including art contemplation; actual reading speed varies. Not a claim of full serialized chapter length.
